hooks.command: tmpfile=$(mktemp); if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ]; then codex exec review --uncommitted --skip-git-repo-check -o "$tmpfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; else codex exec review --commit HEAD --skip-git-repo-check -o "$tmpfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; msg=$(cat "$tmpfile" 2>/dev/null); rm -f "$tmpfile"; if [ -z "$msg" ]; then msg="(codex review 沒有輸出)"; fi; python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': 'Codex review:\n\n' + sys.argv[1]}))" "$msg" 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Codex 正在 review 這輪的變更...
